capability.summary: Retrieve Rick and Morty characters, episodes, or locations
capability.description: Calls the Rick and Morty API with an optional resource path (default character) and optional id. The wrapper performs no allowlist validation and may splice any non-empty path segment into the API URL. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Rick and Morty fictional-universe reference lookup; not general media search, episode streaming, or factual biography.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional non-empty resource path (default character) and optional id; output: JSON envelope containing http_status and Rick and Morty API JSON or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional non-empty resource path segment; wrapper default character and does not enforce an allowlist
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed base https://rickandmortyapi.com/api/<resource>[/<id>]; any non-empty resource segment may be spliced into the URL without allowlist validation
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
no filters, search query, pagination controls, or batch ids exposed; wrapper preserves the API response without local parsing or truncation
public endpoint needs no auth but has provider rate limits; no cache or retry

input_contract.name: resource
input_contract.description: Optional resource path segment; wrapper defaults to character and does not enforce an allowlist.

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing a Rick and Morty character, episode, location, or collection response, URL, and HTTP status.

retrieve Rick and Morty episode or location data
